mechanics.argument_split: The listing, not the decompiler, fixes the order: the word at entry ESP+0x04 is the insertion position and the word at entry ESP+0x08 is the type id. The decompiler names the second word nTypeID but also treats the first as an output pointer.
mechanics.all_types_branch: When the type word equals 0xffffffff the body skips the lookup and walks the whole table. It starts at buckets[0], skips null slots with an unbounded forward probe (0x008dff51..0x008dff6b and 0x008dfff9..0x008e000a), and terminates only when the current chain head equals buckets[bucket_count] (0x008e000e).
mechanics.chain_exhaustion: When node->next at +0x18 is null the scan resumes at the next non-null bucket slot instead of stopping, so a chain that ends in null is not the loop terminator; only the sentinel value is.
mechanics.specific_type_branch: Otherwise the receiver map at +0x30 is queried through the thiscall helper at 0x00aea1b0 with the address of the type word; the resulting 8-byte iterator pair is read from the local at entry ESP-0x08.
mechanics.miss_and_empty: If the returned node equals buckets[bucket_count] (0x008e0040..0x008e0043) or the node's chunk is empty (0x008e004f..0x008e0051) the function returns the untouched counter without allocating.
mechanics.append: For every chunk entry the body allocates one 12-byte node through 0x00f473a0 with the EASTL arguments (0x0c, 0x013f2150, 0, 0, 0x013ebb38, 0xd1), stores entry[0] at node+0x08, then performs a doubly linked insert before the position: node->next = position, node->prev = position->prev, position->prev->next = node, position->prev = node.
mechanics.ordering: The position iterator is never advanced, so repeated inserts in front of a list sentinel preserve source order while a mid-list position prepends; both spellings of the block (0x008dff9e..0x008dffe8 and 0x008e0060..0x008e00a0) are byte-for-byte equivalent apart from register choice.
mechanics.counter: EDI is incremented once per allocated node before the allocator call and is copied to EAX at both exits, so the result is the number of appended elements and 0 on every miss, empty-chunk or all-types-with-no-entry path.
mechanics.no_side_effects: The body performs no deallocation, no cache mutation and no write through the map; the only writes are into the freshly allocated list nodes and into the caller's list links.

class_evidence.analogue: Resource::cResourceManager::Initialize at 0x008de530 (reconstruction/staging/wave6-resources/resource_index.cpp) establishes the same 12-byte map header with buckets at +0x04 and the end slot at +0x08, and is the source of the 0xffffffff end-sentinel value.

semantic_findings: The function is a collector, not a getter: it appends one list node per matching chunk entry into a caller-owned intrusive list and returns how many it appended.
The decompiler's wchar16* return is a decompilation artefact of an EDI counter reaching EAX; the counter is a full 32-bit element count.
0xffffffff is an in-band all-types query, not an error code: it takes the full-table walk branch and never calls the map lookup.
The two duplicated append blocks show the same source statement reached from two branches, so the specific-type path is the -1 path with a lookup bolted in front.
The unbounded null-bucket probe is safe only because the end sentinel slot is non-null, which ties this body to the Initialize-time sentinel contract.

unresolved_questions: Whether the collected 4-byte word at chunk entry +0x00 is a const char* typename pointer, a Resource type id or another handle: the listing only proves a 4-byte copy, and the pointee type is taken from the SDK name, not from evidence.
What the second word of each 8-byte chunk entry holds; the body never reads offset +0x04.
Whether the insertion position is a list end() sentinel, a mid-list iterator, or a caller-owned anchor, since the function has no call xrefs and only the virtual slot at 0x01436ae8+0x4c is known.

Why the map stores a half-open range of entries per key rather than a single value; the chunked representation is inferred from the +0x04/+0x08 pair and the 0x8 stride and is not confirmed by a writer in this package.
The literal value of the end sentinel is taken from resource_manager_initialize_008de530, not from this body.
blockers: No direct caller or SDK prototype pins the declared order or spelling of the two stack words, so the parameter names are modelling choices.
The destination container is only known through its node layout, so no EASTL or std list type name is claimed.
